name: Game Data
description: Browse and open the installed game's files (models, textures, SLKs, scripts) read-only.

mcpTools.name: search_game_files
mcpTools.description: Finds files in the installed game, by the path object data and scripts use: models for effects and missiles, icons, sounds. Spell effects are under Abilities\Spells and Abilities\Weapons. A file with `only` is missing in the other graphics modes, where a model simply doesn't show: prefer those without.

filter.description: Parts of the path, separated by spaces, not case sensitive: fire missile.

extension.description: Only these, like mdx, blp or txt.

mcpTools.name: read_game_file
mcpTools.description: A text file of the installed game, like Scripts\Blizzard.j, or UI\TriggerData.txt.

offset.description: Start at this character (for files too long for one read).
